tasks.requirements: Upgrade Java 8 to Java 25 LTS as targeted by the report. Resolve and approve the framework/tooling compatibility path first; preserve inherited plugin versions and validate both modules.
Resolve both Common Annotations removed-module incidents using APIs and namespaces appropriate to the approved Java 25/framework path; preserve lifecycle behavior.

tasks.description: Migrate the Local Resource to Azure
tasks.requirements: Resolve Local JDBC Calls and Localhost Usage in both modules using Azure PostgreSQL and compatible Azure-hosted RabbitMQ. Confirm resources, authentication, TLS, data transfer, and endpoints before cutover. Externalize cloud configuration while preserving local development; do not replace RabbitMQ with Service Bus.

tasks.description: Migrate to Azure Storage Account File Share mounts
tasks.requirements: Review all 14 NIO incidents. Mount the same Azure Files asset share in both apps, explicitly activate compatible profile-selected storage implementations and storageType values, and retain isolated disposable worker scratch files. Preserve storage interfaces, S3 backend, and thumbnail naming.

tasks.description: Containerize Java Application for Container Readiness
tasks.requirements: Create web and worker Dockerfiles using root-reactor inputs and approved Java 25 images, non-root execution, no baked secrets, bounded scratch storage, and appropriate health/shutdown configuration. Verify images and document external database, broker, secret, and shared-mount configuration. Do not provision or deploy without approval.

tasks.description: Scan and resolve obsolete API usage
tasks.requirements: Revalidate and resolve CWE-477 obsolete MVC/interceptor adapters without changing routing or logging behavior. Record rescan evidence.

tasks.description: Scan and resolve numeric, allocation, and resource-release weaknesses
tasks.requirements: Resolve CWE-681/CWE-682 through positive bounded aspect-preserving thumbnail dimensions; resolve CWE-772/CWE-775 through reliable stream/writer/handle cleanup on failures; resolve CWE-789 by checking overflow-safe decoded image limits before raster allocation. Test narrow images, limits, overflow, and injected I/O failures. Record rescan evidence.

Resolve CWE-662 metadata-commit/message-consumption ordering and CWE-820 partial shared-file publication. Verify across processes/replicas and actual Azure Files semantics; do not rely on JVM-only locks. Preserve manual ack/nack behavior and test deterministic concurrency cases. Record rescan evidence.

tasks.description: Scan and resolve hard-coded credentials and insufficient logging
tasks.requirements: Resolve CWE-259/CWE-798 confirmed embedded credentials using required external secrets without silent defaults; document owner-managed rotation. Resolve CWE-778 deletion/security failure logging while excluding secrets. Keep startup scripts consistent. Record rescan evidence.

tasks.description: Scan and resolve traversal, resource injection, and unsafe uploads
tasks.requirements: Resolve CWE-22/CWE-23/CWE-36/CWE-99 through root-confined validation of upload names, HTTP keys, and worker message keys including symlink escapes. Resolve CWE-434 using server-side image format/signature/size validation before storage or publication, sharing the bounded decode policy from Task 007. Add isolated adversarial regressions and record rescan evidence.

tasks.description: Scan and resolve command and argument injection
tasks.requirements: Resolve CWE-77/CWE-78/CWE-88 in cleanup resource-group argument parsing and command construction. Validate identifiers and argument boundaries without dynamic re-evaluation; keep shell/batch parity. Validate on Windows using a stubbed CLI, never real deletion. Record rescan evidence or an explicit environment blocker.
